technique: MRI brain with contrast; axial T1, T2, FLAIR and DWI with post-contrast sequences.
findings: There is opacification of the left mastoid air cells with erosion of the surrounding bone. An 18 mm rim-enhancing collection lies in the left temporal lobe and shows restricted diffusion centrally, with 6 mm of adjacent cerebritis. There is 7 mm of midline shift to the right. The sigmoid sinus does not enhance. The ventricles are compressed on the left and the basal cisterns remain patent.
impression: Left temporal brain abscess with surrounding cerebritis, mass effect and shift, with sigmoid sinus thrombosis, secondary to coalescent mastoiditis.
recommendations: Immediate joint neurosurgical and ENT management, and intravenous antibiotics chosen to cross the blood-brain barrier. Lumbar puncture is contraindicated with this degree of shift.
follow_up: Repeat imaging if the neurological examination deteriorates, and after drainage to reassess the collection and the shift.
